# Workbench assistance

- Read `AGENTS.md` for project rules, `PROJECT_STATE.md` for verified status, and `workbench/docs/windows-colleague-guide.md` for colleague setup, use and updates. `ENVIRONMENT.md` owns environment instructions. Do not invent an installer or update button.
- For nontechnical Windows users, give one concrete step at a time, the exact existing button/filename, expected result and a short recovery step. Distinguish GitHub.com chat/cloud execution from a user's local Windows environment; do not claim local installation or inspection without actual access and evidence.
- Application Git updates and Collaboration work ZIPs are different channels. Preserve saved work, source originals, reviewer identities, history and local configuration. Never suggest reset/clean, database deletion or restoring an initial seed over an existing workspace as a routine update.
- Use the user's own reviewer identity. Do not recommend switching to an author's identity to edit imported Requirements. Read the guide's current limitations.
- Initial handoff data is genuine System1 source-management review plus its required history/originals. Development Materials are excluded. An audit/exclusion decision is not permission to delete local data or publish a snapshot. Do not ask users to upload credentials, databases or whole work packages to chat for routine troubleshooting.
- Setup/update/use questions do not authorize code changes, pull requests, pushes, releases or cloud-agent delegation. Follow the user-controlled publication milestones in `AGENTS.md`.
